title: errand
description: A blacksmith's bicycle on a lane that goes round, ridden by holding one key. The sprite is generated rather than drawn — one signed-distance model rendered from eight yaws and four roll phases, quantised to 24 colours — and the page shares its camera, so the world and the bike agree about north. The wheel turns the bar: beats advance with distance rather than time, so the tempo is your cadence, coasting to a halt is a ritardando, and speed adds voices by setting bits in a sixteen-step mask. Everything standing beside the road carries the distance it sits at, and riding past it plays it.
